# Release v0.1.0 — APEX Swarm Fabric

**Released:** 2026-05-21  
**Commit:** 890f70ab357a980edce7096e25b6ebbe3bf6a376  
**Branch merged:** feat/m2a-swarm-fabric → main

## What's in v0.1.0

39 files across 8 directories implementing the full M2A Swarm Fabric for xAI Colossus v2 cooling.

### Modules
- M2A Middleware — pillar-based router + aggregator + JSON schema contracts
- Telemetry Agent — 800M streams/s Kafka pipeline + Flink processor
- TEMPEST/SCIF — EMI shielding specs + access control
- Water Management (Phase 2) — triple-source failover, 10M litre cistern, RO plant, Grok pre-cooling
- GPU Cluster Agent (Phase 4) — 2M GPU hierarchy, 27,778 NVL72 nodes, thermal throttle coordinator
- Commissioning — 8-phase sequence + KPI validator
- main.py — unified async entrypoint
- APEX_MANIFEST.json — machine-readable connector manifest

### KPIs Targeted
| Metric | Target |
|--------|--------|
| PUE | 1.03 |
| WCI | 0.0 L/kWh |
| Cistern autonomy | 72 hr |
| GPU mean die temp | ≤ 72°C |
| Cluster size | 2,000,000 GPUs |
| NVL72 nodes | 27,778 |
| Telemetry throughput | 800M streams/s |
| Water source switch | < 5s |

### Security
- SQL injection fix (MotherDuck analytics) — live on main
- API auth (thermal snapshot proxy) — merged PR #5
- TEMPEST/SCIF layer documented
- All API keys via environment variables only
